name: Fortified Armor Training
benefit:
If an opponent scores a critical hit against you, you can turn the critical hit into a normal hit. If you do, either your armor or your shield gains the broken condition (your choice).
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 120
When you use this feat to negate a critical hit, you can spend 5 stamina points to give your armor or shield a 50% chance to avoid gaining the broken condition.
flavor: You have learned to let your armor bear the brunt of the worst attacks.
